title: Mechanism-level deduplication: collapse vocabulary entries that name one mechanism twice
question: Which canonical mechanism ids are the same mechanism under two names - the spec's mechanism-level deduplication requirement applied to the vocabulary itself rather than to workflows - and does collapsing them change the leverage ranking?
decision: On the closed vocabulary actually present on this worktree (source=closed-fixture; live WFA-0058=False; live WFA-0059=False), MECH-CONFLICT-REFUSE and MECH-UNION-GUARD are the same mechanism under two names: incidence Jaccard 0.7778 and definition-prototype accuracy 0.1667 both fire, so MECH-UNION-GUARD is aliased to MECH-CONFLICT-REFUSE via a duplicate-of edge and is not deleted. MECH-SBAR-HANDOFF and MECH-PEER-REVIEW share an incidence set (Jaccard 1.0) because they co-occur on the same artifacts, but definition-prototype accuracy 1.0 tells them apart, so they are not collapsed. Incidence-only collapse of that pair is the negative control. Collapsing the synonym pair changes leverage: survivor independent sources 5->6, score 45->54, ranked count 12->11. Frequency ranking still promotes MECH-ECHO-COPY; leverage ranking does not.

rules.statement: Collapse requires incidence Jaccard at or above threshold AND a failed blind discrimination test. Incidence overlap alone can be a shared source.
Each collapse writes a duplicate-of edge from the alias to the canonical id. The alias remains in mechanism_ids.
Leverage is independent_source_count * severity * decision_impact. Ranking is recomputed after unioning incidence onto the canonical id, and the delta is reported.

claims.claim: MECH-CONFLICT-REFUSE and MECH-UNION-GUARD collapse under both signals; MECH-SBAR-HANDOFF and MECH-PEER-REVIEW do not, despite incidence overlap.
Collapsed ids remain as aliases with duplicate-of edges; ids_deleted is empty.
Leverage ranking after collapse differs from the pre-collapse ranking; frequency ranking still disagrees with leverage on the echo cluster.

both_states.fires_on: incidence-only mutant of the AND-gate, which merges MECH-SBAR-HANDOFF/MECH-PEER-REVIEW (Jaccard 1.0)
both_states.silent_on: production AND-gate on the same pair, which refuses collapse because discrimination accuracy=1.0

negative_controls.rejects: collapsing a pair on incidence Jaccard without a failed discrimination test
negative_controls.observed: mutant merged MECH-SBAR-HANDOFF/MECH-PEER-REVIEW; production did not

evidence.claim: AND-gate on synonym vs shared-source pair
evidence.mechanism: incidence Jaccard over artifact-id sets AND definition-prototype assignment of held-out examples
evidence.verbatim: synonym jaccard=0.7778 acc=0.1667 collapse=true; shared jaccard=1.0 acc=1.0 collapse=false

evidence.mechanism: independent upstream set of the unioned incidence; frequency ranking published beside it

reviewer.method: Probe2 does not call discriminate(). It leave-one-out 1-NN classifies example texts, reconstructs the pre-collapse id set from duplicate-of edges, and checks that frequency rank and leverage rank disagree on MECH-ECHO-COPY.
